changelog:
- Support for querying booli.se property data from the shell using the fpx CLI, without running the MCP server.
- Enables area lookup, for-sale and sold listing searches, and property detail retrieval via one-shot GraphQL calls routed through a signed-in browser tab.
- Requires the Transporter browser extension and a paired, open booli.se tab (no Booli login needed).
- Includes clear setup instructions, exit codes, and practical jq recipes for processing responses.
- Recommended for users needing Booli data in scripts or environments without the MCP installed.
summary: Query booli.se (Swedish property portal) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the booli-mcp server — resolve areas, search for-sale and sold listings (slutpriser), and read property detail via one-shot GraphQL calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want Booli data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
